ruling: There is no async repository or query layer yet. Raw SQL on an endpoint's async connection stays where it is (routers, identity_resolution_service.persist_manual_match) until one exists; moving it behind the repository layer is deferred, not rejected.

Moving an INSERT or a read query that runs inside the endpoint's async transaction onto a sync repository would split the transaction; creating the first async query layer is a separate design decision. Lance chose extraction-only for AUD-054 (pass 6) and AUD-004 (pass 7).

ruling: Only mb_enrichment_task and library_enrichment_task share a task-run lifecycle envelope (backend/tasks/_task_run.task_run). library_scan_task, library_scan_files_task (watcher), ingestion_task and library_hash_backfill_task keep their own envelopes, and task_failure_telemetry keeps its FAILED-only contract.
rationale: A gate-0 inventory (2026-09-29) found the six envelopes differ in observable rows (watcher and ingestion write no SystemLog; library_scan's failed log has no traceback; FAILED payload keys differ), in connection ownership (hash backfill keeps progress on its non-autocommit batch transaction by design), and in how a chained task's failure is attributed. Unifying them would change behaviour. The enrichment pair is the one shape AUD-025's evidence covers (9 shared commits). Lance ruled 2026-09-29; the behaviour differences are addressed separately by declared fixes (see AUD-R012 when recorded).
supersedes: AUD-021/AUD-025 recommendation to extend the envelope to all tasks

ruling: (1) Chained task calls are Huey enqueues; a chained task's run failure is its own to report. The caller owns only the handoff: if enqueueing the next task fails, the caller writes an ERROR SystemLog `<next_task>_enqueue_failed` (error + traceback, on its own task_id) and keeps its own COMPLETED status. Applies to library_scan_task, the watcher (library_scan_files_task), library_enrichment_task and ingestion_task. (2) The watcher and ingestion_task write started / completed / failed SystemLogs like their peers. (3) Failed-run SystemLogs carry a traceback: library_scan_task and _error_boundary.task_failure_telemetry (artist matching, identity matching, embedding, normalize backfill, hash backfill).
rationale: Lance, 2026-09-29, after the AUD-021/025 gate-0 inventory showed enqueue failures were handled three different ways (flipping a successful scan/watcher run to FAILED, escaping unrecorded from library enrichment, silently swallowed by ingestion) and two tasks left no SystemLog trail. Implemented by PR #114, squash-merged to master as d89faf7 on 2026-09-29. Only the SqliteHuey storage error (sqlite3.Error) counts as a failed handoff; any other exception from the enqueue call is a defect and propagates.
supersedes: ingestion_tasks comment 'a broker hiccup here is a separate operational concern' implemented as suppress(Exception): the concern stays separate, but it is now logged
